title: YouTubeLiveNotificationRequest
description: Service-authenticated request for the primary Discord Bot to publish the active stream's YouTube watch URL. Channel IDs are resolved from runtime config and must not be accepted from this payload.

event_id.description: Idempotency key. Reusing it with a different stream or URL is a conflict.

watch_url.description: Canonical HTTPS YouTube watch URL without credentials, fragment, or a non-default port.
